title: 副词比较级与 enough

examples.en: He is old enough to go to school.

guess.question: enough 应该放在形容词的前面还是后面？

options.feedback: 对！enough 修饰形容词和副词时要后置，这是它跟别的词不一样的地方。
不对——enough 修饰形容词副词必须放后面，放前面就错了。
不对——只能放后面；只有修饰名词时（enough time）才放前面。

rule.rule: 副词比较级前可加 much / even / a lot / a little 表示程度；enough 修饰形容词或副词时必须后置，修饰名词时放在名词前
rule.formula: ① 副修动比较：He runs faster than me.　② much / even / a lot / a little + 比较级　③ 形容词 / 副词 + enough：old enough / fast enough　④ enough + 名词：enough time

anchors.en: He doesn't run fast enough to catch the bus.
anchors.zh: 他跑得不够快，赶不上那班车。

anchors.en: The room is big enough for us to live in.
anchors.zh: 这房间够大，我们住得下。

trap.wrong: He is enough old to go to school.
trap.right: He is old enough to go to school.
trap.why: enough 修饰形容词要放在后面：old enough。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——enough 跟在形容词副词后面，但放在名词前面（enough time）。

check.stem: Don't worry about him. He is ____ to look after himself.

options.distractor: enough 要放在形容词后面
这里有 enough 就不需要比较级

check.stem: Please speak ____ so that everyone can hear you.

options.distractor: 语序错，且 loud 本身可作副词

The box is enough light for me to carry.
The box is light enough for me carry.
